name: mac-design
description: Design native-feeling macOS app UI in the Liquid Glass era (macOS 26 "Tahoe"). The context AI design tools lack, so output stops drifting toward web dashboards and iOS ports: the two-layer glass model, window/toolbar/sidebar/menu-bar conventions, Mac metrics and color, a SwiftUI API map, and an anti-slop checklist. Applies to SwiftUI/AppKit apps and HTML/CSS Mac-app mockups alike.
